content.json:
# AppGW → APIM → Azure AI Foundry — End-to-End Trace

Distributed trace waterfall stitched across three layers via **X-Correlation-Id**:

| Layer | Data Source | Metric |
|---|---|---|
| **App Gateway WAF** | `AGWAccessLogs` (Log Analytics) | Total connection time from client |
| **APIM Gateway** | `AppRequests` (App Insights) | APIM processing + backend call |
| **Azure AI Foundry** | `AppDependencies` (App Insights) | Foundry model inference time |

**How correlation works:** The App Gateway rewrite rule stamps `X-Correlation-Id: client_ip-client_port` on every forwarded request (Azure App Gateway does not expose a per-request UUID; the TCP source port is unique per active connection, so this pair is unique within any live request window). APIM captures it as `Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"]` in App Insights and forwards it to Foundry. The APIM → Foundry join uses the header value directly. The AppGW row is matched approximately using the client IP from the corrId and the APIM request time binned to 2 seconds.

> Use the **Correlation ID** parameter above to drill into a single request trace.

content.query:
// Summary tiles: total volume and avg per-layer latency
let apimRequests = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId);
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Type == "HTTP"
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId);
union
  (apimRequests
   | summarize
       Value = toreal(count()),
       Sub   = strcat("avg ", round(avg(DurationMs), 0), " ms")
   | extend Metric = "Total Requests"),
  (apimRequests
   | summarize
       Value = round(avg(DurationMs), 0),
       Sub   = "milliseconds"
   | extend Metric = "Avg APIM Latency"),
  (foundryDeps
   | summarize
       Value = round(avg(DurationMs), 0),
       Sub   = "milliseconds"
   | extend Metric = "Avg Foundry Latency"),
  (apimRequests
   | where Success == false
   | summarize
       Value = toreal(count()),
       Sub   = "errors"
   | extend Metric = "Failed Requests")
| project Metric, Value, Sub
content.title: Traffic overview (APIM-correlated requests only)

content.json:
## Per-Layer Latency Waterfall

Each bar represents **average time spent in that layer** for requests in the selected time window. APIM overhead = `APIM duration âˆ’ Foundry duration`.

content.query:
// Per-layer latency waterfall â€” stacked bar per time bucket
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project TimeGenerated, corrId, apimDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Type == "HTTP"
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project corrId, foundryDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let appgwLogs = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(RequestUri)   // transactionId not always populated; use URI as fallback grouping
| project TimeGenerated, timeTakenMs = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000;
apimReqs
| join kind=leftouter foundryDeps on corrId
| extend foundryMs   = iff(isnotempty(foundryDurationMs), foundryDurationMs, 0.0)
| extend apimOverheadMs = max_of(apimDurationMs - foundryMs, 0.0)
| summarize
    avgAppgwMs      = 0.0,      // App GW timing joined separately â€” see note below
    avgApimOverheadMs = avg(apimOverheadMs),
    avgFoundryMs    = avg(foundryMs)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend t = TimeGenerated
| project t, ['App GW overhead'] = avgAppgwMs, ['APIM overhead'] = avgApimOverheadMs, ['Foundry inference'] = avgFoundryMs
content.title: Avg latency per layer (5-min buckets)

content.json:
## Full App Gateway + APIM Join

Matches each `AppRequests` row to its `AGWAccessLogs` entry via an **approximate join**: client IP is extracted from the corrId (`client_ip-client_port`) and matched against `AGWAccessLogs` within a 2-second time bucket centred on the APIM request start time.

> Azure Application Gateway does not expose a per-request UUID server variable. The TCP source port + client IP pair is unique for any active connection. Within a 2-second window with the same client IP the closest AGW entry is matched.

content.query:
// Full 3-layer trace table: AGW â†’ APIM â†’ Foundry
// corrId format: "client_ip-client_port" stamped by AppGW rewrite rule.
// APIM â†’ Foundry: direct join on the shared corrId header value.
// AppGW â†’ APIM:   approximate join using client IP (from corrId) + APIM start time binned to 2s.
let filter_corrId = "{CorrelationId}";
let apimRows = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project
    corrId,
    opId             = OperationId,
    apimStart        = TimeGenerated,
    apimDurationMs   = DurationMs,
    httpStatus       = ResultCode,
    success          = Success,
    url              = Url,
    apimProduct      = tostring(Properties["Product"]),
    apimSubscription = tostring(Properties["Subscription"]);
let foundryRows = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Type == "HTTP"
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| summarize
    foundryDurationMs = avg(DurationMs),
    foundryTarget     = any(Target),
    foundrySuccess    = any(Success)
    by corrId, opId = OperationId;
let agwRows = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project
    agwStart         = TimeGenerated,
    agwTimeTakenMs   = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000,
    agwClientIp      = ClientIp,
    agwHttpStatus    = HttpStatus,
    agwSentBytes     = SentBytes,
    agwReceivedBytes = ReceivedBytes,
    agwKey           = strcat(ClientIp, "~", tostring(bin(TimeGenerated, 2s)));
apimRows
| join kind=leftouter foundryRows on corrId
// corrId = "clientIp-port" â€” extract client IP as join key
| extend corrClientIp = tostring(split(corrId, "-")[0])
| extend approxKey    = strcat(corrClientIp, "~", tostring(bin(apimStart, 2s)))
| join kind=leftouter agwRows on $left.approxKey == $right.agwKey
| project-away corrClientIp, approxKey, agwKey
| extend
    apimOverheadMs = max_of(apimDurationMs - iff(isnotempty(foundryDurationMs), foundryDurationMs, 0.0), 0.0),
    agwOverheadMs  = max_of(agwTimeTakenMs - apimDurationMs, 0.0)
| project
    Time               = apimStart,
    ['Correlation ID'] = corrId,
    ['URL']            = url,
    ['Status']         = httpStatus,
    ['Total (ms)']     = round(agwTimeTakenMs, 1),
    ['AppGW (ms)']     = round(agwOverheadMs, 1),
    ['APIM (ms)']      = round(apimOverheadMs, 1),
    ['Foundry (ms)']   = round(foundryDurationMs, 1),
    ['Foundry backend']= foundryTarget,
    ['APIM product']   = apimProduct,
    ['Client IP']      = agwClientIp,
    ['Success']        = success
| sort by Time desc
content.title: Per-request trace table (AppGW + APIM + Foundry)

content.json:
## P50 / P95 / P99 Latency by Layer

Use this to identify which layer is the latency bottleneck for your slowest requests.

content.query:
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project corrId, apimDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Type == "HTTP"
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| summarize foundryMs = avg(DurationMs) by corrId;
apimReqs
| join kind=leftouter foundryDeps on corrId
| extend foundryMs        = iff(isnotempty(foundryMs), foundryMs, 0.0)
| extend apimOverheadMs   = max_of(apimDurationMs - foundryMs, 0.0)
| summarize
    ['APIM overhead p50']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  50), 1),
    ['APIM overhead p95']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  95), 1),
    ['APIM overhead p99']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  99), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p50']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       50), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p95']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       95), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p99']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       99), 1),
    ['Total APIM p50']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  50), 1),
    ['Total APIM p95']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  95), 1),
    ['Total APIM p99']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  99), 1)
| project Stat = "Latency (ms)",
    ['APIM overhead p50'], ['APIM overhead p95'], ['APIM overhead p99'],
    ['Foundry inference p50'], ['Foundry inference p95'], ['Foundry inference p99'],
    ['Total APIM p50'], ['Total APIM p95'], ['Total APIM p99']
content.title: Latency percentiles by layer (ms)

content.json:
## WAF Firewall Events

Any request **blocked or matched** by the WAF (OWASP CRS 3.2 + Bot Manager). A high matched-but-allowed count may indicate false-positive rules worth tuning.

content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    Blocked = countif(Action == "Blocked"),
    Matched = countif(Action == "Matched"),
    Total   = count()
    by RuleSetType, RuleId, Message
| sort by Blocked desc, Total desc
| project
    ['Rule Set']  = RuleSetType,
    ['Rule ID']   = RuleId,
    Message,
    Blocked,
    Matched,
    Total
content.title: WAF rule matches / blocks

content.json:
## App Insights Transaction Search Link

For a **single-request drill-down** (every span on one timeline similar to Jaeger), set the **Correlation ID** parameter above, then copy the `opId` value from the trace table and paste it into [App Insights â†’ Transaction Search](https://portal.azure.com) (`operation_Id = <opId>`). This shows the W3C-correlated APIM frontend span, APIMâ†’Foundry dependency span, and any OpenTelemetry spans your client code emits â€” all linked by the same `operation_Id`.
